meta_description_en: Overview of bonus programs, utilities, screens, and mods featured in the Add-Enders section of Outlet magazine issue #039.
meta_description_ru: Обзор бонусных материалов и утилит в разделе Add-Enders журнала Outlet #039: программы, графика, модификации и демо.
body_en_plain:
Some items contributed to OUTLET
have not yet been included for a
variety of reasons. It's a shame
to leave them on the shelf so,if
appropriate, they will be added
to this ADD-ENDERS area of the
magazine (not microdrive or Opus
as there is not enough room).

The material covers a wide range
of quality and program types:
utilities, screens, character
sets and text articles and SOME
of it may be unedited, untested,
not working fully or properly;
in need of conversion for your

system's syntax or printer etc.;
without full instructions or
whatever. Readers will have to
sift through to see if there is
anything of interest they can
make use of and discard the
rest. Not everything will appear
on all versions necessarily.

Some Add-Enders may be linked to
OUTLET in the normal way. These
will usually precede this text
file. Any items that follow this
article will possibly need to be
LOADed manually or may not auto-
run when loaded.

There may be some info on the
following pages...

Next in ADD-ENDERS is"ADD-VERTS"
-our full-screen advert section.

This is followed by "FRACTION",a
further offering by Chris Ingram
in a short series of educational
programs for children of primary
school age. FRACTION loads FR1
and FR2 which include declared
variables not in the listings so
do not use CLEAR or RUN if you
BREAK in to reSAVE etc. This is
likely to mean I can't transfer
them to SAM which is a pity.

"prodata" is another crossword
puzzle from Hugh McGregor. This
must be loaded into PROCROSS
(OUTLET 31) from where it can be
solved on-screen (if you're very
clever) or printed out.

"SATSCAN.C" is a giant,scrolling
satellite image of the British
Isles from Grant Dixon. This has
to be loaded into SCANDUMP in
OUTLET 17 to view or print it.

There's another item featuring a
large scrolling screen and this
is BoB Smith's "CLASDEMO" which
demonstrates his OUTCLASS code
this month. I note that prompts
in this demo refer to "cursor
keys"but these are the unshifted
cursor keys: 5, 6, 7 and 8 as on
the original 48K Spectrum - not
the arrow keys (Poor old BoB's
still living in the past. He was
never the same after they tried
to tear him away from his old
rubber keyboard, poor chap.)
                       more!...

"ART2MODS" is a modified ARTIST
2 BASIC from Alan Fortune. This
should correct the printer bugs.
Note that Disciple syntax is
used so you may need to change
this for your system.

There are a couple of SCREEN$ by
Glenn Owens: "BIGGER.S" and a v.
useful one giving big characters
in relief called"RELIEF.S" which
is ideally suited for desktop
publishing or screen creation by
using CLIP COMPOSER (OUTLET 29).

Finally, there are a dozen more
clip art SCREEN$ from the large
stock sent by Leif Mortensen.
They are SAVEd as "CLIP2.19" TO
"CLIP2.30". (I think last month
I missed the "2." off the front
of the names).          - Brian.

body_en:
## Addender

Some items contributed to OUTLET have not yet been included for a variety of reasons. It's a shame to leave them on the shelf so, if appropriate, they will be added to this ADD-ENDERS area of the magazine (not microdrive or Opus as there is not enough room).

The material covers a wide range of quality and program types: utilities, screens, character sets and text articles and SOME of it may be unedited, untested, not working fully or properly; in need of conversion for your system's syntax or printer etc.; without full instructions or whatever. Readers will have to sift through to see if there is anything of interest they can make use of and discard the rest. Not everything will appear on all versions necessarily.

Some Add-Enders may be linked to OUTLET in the normal way. These will usually precede this text file. Any items that follow this article will possibly need to be LOADed manually or may not auto-run when loaded.

There may be some info on the following pages...

Next in ADD-ENDERS is "ADD-VERTS" - our full-screen advert section.

This is followed by "FRACTION", a further offering by Chris Ingram in a short series of educational programs for children of primary school age. FRACTION loads FR1 and FR2 which include declared variables not in the listings so do not use CLEAR or RUN if you BREAK in to reSAVE etc. This is likely to mean I can't transfer them to SAM which is a pity.

"prodata" is another crossword puzzle from Hugh McGregor. This must be loaded into PROCROSS (OUTLET 31) from where it can be solved on-screen (if you're very clever) or printed out.

"SATSCAN.C" is a giant, scrolling satellite image of the British Isles from Grant Dixon. This has to be loaded into SCANDUMP in OUTLET 17 to view or print it.

There's another item featuring a large scrolling screen and this is BoB Smith's "CLASDEMO" which demonstrates his OUTCLASS code this month. I note that prompts in this demo refer to "cursor keys" but these are the unshifted cursor keys: 5, 6, 7 and 8 as on the original 48K Spectrum - not the arrow keys (Poor old BoB's still living in the past. He was never the same after they tried to tear him away from his old rubber keyboard, poor chap.)

"ART2MODS" is a modified ARTIST 2 BASIC from Alan Fortune. This should correct the printer bugs. Note that Disciple syntax is used so you may need to change this for your system.

There are a couple of SCREEN$ by Glenn Owens: "BIGGER.S" and a v. useful one giving big characters in relief called "RELIEF.S" which is ideally suited for desktop publishing or screen creation by using CLIP COMPOSER (OUTLET 29).

Finally, there are a dozen more clip art SCREEN$ from the large stock sent by Leif Mortensen. They are SAVEd as "CLIP2.19" TO "CLIP2.30". (I think last month I missed the "2." off the front of the names).

— Brian.

## Раздел Add-Enders

Некоторые из Add-Enders могут быть привязаны к меню OUTLET штатным образом. Они обычно предшествуют этому тексту. Всё, что следует за этой статьей, возможно, придется грузить вручную через LOAD, или оно не запустится автоматически.

Кое-какая информация найдется на следующих страницах...

Далее в ADD-ENDERS — "ADD-VERTS", наш раздел полноэкранной рекламы.

Затем идет "FRACTION", очередная работа от Chris Ingram из серии обучающих программ для детей младшего школьного возраста. FRACTION грузит FR1 и FR2, где есть объявленные переменные не из листинга, так что не делайте CLEAR или RUN, если нажмете BREAK ради reSAVE и т.д. Похоже, я не смогу перенести их на SAM, а очень жаль.

"prodata" — еще один кроссворд от Hugh McGregor. Его нужно загрузить в PROCROSS (OUTLET 31), откуда его можно отгадывать прямо на экране (если вы очень умны) или же распечатать.

"SATSCAN.C" — гигантский снимок Британских островов со спутника со скроллингом от Grant Dixon. Его нужно загрузить в SCANDUMP из OUTLET 17 для просмотра или печати.

Есть еще один файл с большим скроллящимся экраном — это "CLASDEMO" от BoB Smith, где он показывает свою процедуру OUTCLASS за этот месяц. Замечу: подсказки в демке говорят про "cursor keys", но имеются в виду кнопки 5, 6, 7 и 8 без сдвига, как на исходном 48K Spectrum, а не стрелочки (Бедный старина BoB все еще живет в прошлом. Он так и не оправился после того, как его попытались оторвать от любимой резиновой клавиатуры, бедолага.)

"ART2MODS" — модифицированный BASIC для ARTIST 2 от Alan Fortune. Он должен устранить баги с печатью. Учтите, что там используется синтаксис Disciple, так что под свою систему его, возможно, придется исправить.

Пара SCREEN$ от Glenn Owens: "BIGGER.S" и оч. полезный экран с крупными объемными буквами "RELIEF.S", отлично подходящий для верстки или рисования заставок через CLIP COMPOSER (OUTLET 29).

И наконец, еще дюжина картинок SCREEN$ из огромных запасов клип-арта от Leif Mortensen. Они сохранены как "CLIP2.19" — "CLIP2.30". (Кажется, в прошлом месяце я забыл дописать "2." в начале названий).
